title: Practice 7: Numerals, nouns and adjectives together

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: На улице два ___ (автомобиль): красный и серебристый.
exercises.prompt: There are two cars on the street: a red one and a silver one.
exercises.why: Numerals are declined in Russian. They have their own pattern of declension. The number «ОДИН» acts as an adjective. It agrees with the nouns to which it refers in gender, number and case. ОДИН (ОДНА, ОДНО) declines like этот (ЭТА, ЭТО). Adjectives and possessives after numerals agree as a rule in number, gender and case with the noun they modify: *одна ваша новая машина; пять ваших новых машин.* However, there is an exception to this rule: after 2, 3, 4 (also after compounds ending in 2, 3, 4) the adjective or possessive is in the genitive plural, while the noun is in the genitive singular: *два наших самолёта; двадцать четыре новых самолёта. — DLI, Lesson 70.  ·  «If the number ends in 2, 3 or 4 use the genitive singular … If the number ends in 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 0 or -надцать use the genitive plural.» «There are also other quantity words that take the genitive, either singular or plural according to meaning: Много, Несколько, Мало, Сколько.» — Wikibooks, «Genitive case».
exercises.context: Numerals are declined in Russian. (DLI, Lesson 70)
